children.name: Polychrus liogaster
children.description: Polychrus liogaster or Boulenger's bush anole is a species of bush anole native to Peru, Brazil, Bolivia, and Ecuador.

children.name: Polychrus acutirostris
children.description: Polychrus acutirostris, the Brazilian bush anole, is a species of lizard native to southern and eastern Brazil, Paraguay, Argentina, and eastern Bolivia.

children.name: Polychrus femoralis
children.description: Polychrus femoralis, or Werner's bush anole, is a species of anole native to Ecuador and Peru.

children.name: Polychrus jacquelinae
children.description: Polychrus jacquelinae or Jacqueline's bush anole is a species of bush anole.

children.name: Polychrus gutturosus
children.description: Polychrus gutturosus, also known as Berthold's bush anole or monkey tailed anole, is a species of lizard found in tropical Central and South America.

children.name: Polychrus peruvianus
children.description: Polychrus peruvianus, the Peruvian bush anole, is a species of bush anole native to Peru and Ecuador.

children.name: Polychrus marmoratus
children.description: Polychrus marmoratus or many-colored bush anole is a species of bush anole.
